entities.summary: Jurchen, a notable figure in the history of North Korea, associated with Joseon Dynasty (1392–1636). Preceded by Six Garrisons and Northern Frontier. Their legacy influenced Hong Gyeongnae Rebellion and Late Joseon Northern Provinces.
